rule GoldenTicket_TGT_Cache_Entry {
    meta:
        description = "Detects potential Golden Ticket artifacts in LSASS memory dumps or Kerberos ticket caches"
        author = "SOC Threat Intel"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1558.001"
        date = "2026-04-10"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $s1 = "krbtgt" nocase
        $s2 = "@corp.local" nocase
        $s3 = { 05 04 [2] 00 00 00 00 } // Kerberos PAC signature type: KERB_CHECKSUM_HMAC_SHA1_96_AES256
        $s4 = "NT Authority\\System" nocase
    condition:
        all of ($s*) and filesize < 100MB
}
